name: Corona Remedies Ltd
title: Corona Remedies Ltd - 544644 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Corona Remedies is a branded-India specialty pharma with no capacity-cycle signal; FY26 revenue +17% on 3% volume and 7.8% pricing, Q4 EBITDA margin down ~90bps to 17.6% on growth-investment costs, and FY27 guided at 15% organic revenue growth and 20%+ PAT growth.

triggers.label: Pricing growth ~7.8% per PharmaTrac
triggers.quote: the pricing growth as reported by PharmaTrac is around 7.8%

triggers.label: Wokadine acquired, ~400bps GM dilution
triggers.quote: we are anticipating about 400 basis point of gross margin correction in the first year

triggers.label: FY27 guide 15% organic, 20%+ PAT
triggers.quote: We expect to sustain 15% plus revenue growth organically and 25% revenue growth in acquired brand with 20% plus PAT growth in FY27 too

guidance.quote: We expect to sustain 15% plus revenue growth organically
we are anticipating about 25% revenue growth for at least 3 to 4 years in the Wokadine
20% plus PAT growth in FY27 too
we would be maintaining the gross margins at the range of 80% in the coming years

prior_guidance_check.quote: ahead of our guided range of 15% revenue growth and 20% PAT growth

red_flags.label: Middle East/crude impact on API costs
red_flags.quote: the ol and other parameters impact many active pharmaceutical ingredients

red_flags.label: Short-term OD borrowings tied to FD and acquisition timing
red_flags.quote: why this OD has been created because we acquired a brand named Wokadine on the last day of the month of the March

evasions.topic: Middle East / API cost impact on gross margin
evasions.quote: it is too early to comment on it
I have not nailed down this with this
